about: GTA 6 editions and price: Standard $79.99, Ultimate $99.99 (US list price on the PlayStation Store and Xbox Store, read 2026-10-31; same prices in Rockstar's June 24, 2026 announcement). The gap is exactly $20. Pre-orders and purchases before November 20, 2026 get the Vintage Vice City Pack in either edition. Rockstar's edition comparison lists 16 Ultimate-only items (cars, a boat, revolvers, outfits) and five shops 'only open for business with the Ultimate Edition'. Rockstar's edition picker offers Ultimate as Digital only; the boxed Standard holds a download code. Factory Delta #11.
